root_cause: mineflayer-pathfinder 2.4.5 index.js:163 bot.pathfinder.stop() only arms the sticky module-level stopPathing latch; it is cleared exclusively by the internal stop() at index.js:390, reached from the next resetPath() at index.js:139. halt() called setGoal(null) before stop(), leaving the latch armed, so the following lib/goto.js setGoal(goal) consumed it and rejected immediately with 'Path was stopped before it could be completed!'.
